goal: Crowdsource verification of hardcoded AssumeUTXO snapshot hashes against reconstructed state during normal IBD
Warn users via GUI and RPC if reconstructed UTXO state mismatches the baked-in snapshot commitment
agreement: Substantive support for crowdsourcing snapshot hash verification during normal IBD (Sjors, optout21)
Objections to crashing or stopping IBD on mismatch were resolved by downgrading to a warning (Sjors, ajtowns)
Unaddressed suggestion to persist mismatch warnings across node restarts, awaiting reply (fametrano)

categories.name: validation
why: P3 because it enables independent verification of hardcoded AssumeUTXO snapshots during normal sync
Strengthens confidence in snapshot integrity, but addresses no active defect or consensus hazard
